title: Mastering the CAC to LTV Ratio

cards.title: The Golden Rule of Unit Economics
cards.body:
A healthy business model requires your Customer Lifetime Value (**LTV**) to be at least 3x higher than your Customer Acquisition Cost (**CAC**).

If you spend \$100 to acquire a customer, that customer must generate at least \$300 in gross margin over their lifecycle.

cards.question: What is the standard benchmark LTV:CAC ratio target for a healthy subscription business?
cards.explanation: A 3:1 ratio ensures enough margin to cover operational overhead, churn, and sustainable scaling.

cards.title: Key Takeaway
cards.body: Never scale ad spend until your LTV:CAC ratio consistently crosses the 3x threshold.
